The Pureland Water
 Entity appeared
 and flooded this
 world's present,
 past and future.

The water brought
 monsters, which
hunted people day
and night. Cities
fell one by one,
   covered by
   the sea...

  However, a few
   individuals
  prepare for a
 journey that may
  determine the
fate of the world



------------------
Behold.” the sealed
 city Dharm. Here
three young people
   sent back as
children from the
   ruins of the
future, are living
  with the Elder.
He has reared them
together with his
own granddaughter.

voyage dont dépend
le sort du monde.
